description: Measurement dataset for a security and resilience assessment of Syrian internet infrastructure (2026) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Ibrahem Hasaki (Independent researcher). Release artifacts for a security and resilience assessment of Syria's national internet infrastructure, covering seven autonomous systems and 1,230,080 unique IPv4 addresses, built entirely on measurements that existing platforms collected for their own purposes (RIPEstat, crt.sh, RIPE Atlas, IODA, OONI, Cloudflare Radar, Shodan InternetDB). Coverage: national (SY); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
